pass_conditions: for every declared X value, each fixed camera produces exactly one positive depth-difference foreground component and finite reconstructed points
each condition fits a finite known-cylinder center from both cameras and publishes a complete dual-depth, version-matched coordinate message
for every condition, Coordinator accepts the structural message, table containment is true, mock Executor updates A to the candidate, and Reviewer verifies equality
only world X varies across conditions; all listed controls match the configuration
non_claims: This is a small virtual one-dimensional X step around the golden condition, not an observed reachability, visibility, accuracy, coverage, or safety range.

Known cylinder dimensions, upright orientation, virtual support plane, camera poses, robot pose, empty virtual reference, numerical epsilon, and fitting method are assumptions frozen for this run; no real Orbbec frame, calibration, synchronization, or noise is evaluated.
Coordinator acceptance and table containment do not assess numerical accuracy, collision, reachability, IK, planning, grasping, dynamics, safety, MuJoCo robot action, or hardware control.
